shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "table|dnd|icons|gravity" ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -A20 '"peerDependencies"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/ && sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSettings/withTableSettings.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; grep -n "th\b\|renderHead\|createElement(\"th\|jsx(\"th\|className: b('cell'\|b('head\|b('row\|b('table" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js | head -40; grep -n "theme-light\|--g-color-base-background\b\|--g-color-base-generic\b\|--g-color-line-generic\b\|--g-color-base-selection\b\|--g-color-text-secondary\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/*.css 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -i -E "^(House|Person|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|ChevronLeft|ChevronRight|ChevronsLeft|ChevronsRight|Grip|Bars|Magnifier|ArrowUpArrowDown|Xmark|CircleCheck|Clock|Truck|Ban|Bell|LayoutHeaderCellsLarge|Cube|Receipt|Pencil)\.js$"

grep -o -- "--g-color-[a-z-]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/*.css | sort -u | grep -E "base-background|base-generic|line-generic|base-selection|text-(primary|secondary|hint|brand)|base-brand|base-float|base-simple-hover|base-positive-light|base-warning-light|base-danger-light|base-info-light|base-misc-light|base-utility-light|base-neutral-light" | head -30; echo ---; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ActionsPanel/ActionsPanel.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ActionsPanel/components/CollapseActions/CollapseActions.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; grep -n "interface LabelProps" -A25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | grep -E "theme|size"; grep -n "interface PlaceholderContainerProps" -A30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/PlaceholderContainer/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "export interface TextInputProps" -A5 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; grep -rn "startContent\|hasClear" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -5; echo ---; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.d.ts; grep -n "view\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "ButtonView =" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css; grep -n "selected\|interactive" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ActionsPanel/types.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/; grep -o -- "--g-color-[a-z-]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | grep -E "base-background|base-generic$|line-generic$|base-selection$|text-(primary|secondary|hint|brand)$|base-brand$|base-float$|base-simple-hover$|base-(positive|warning|danger|info|misc|utility|neutral)-light$" ; echo ---; grep -n "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "LabelProps" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | grep -E "theme|size|icon"; echo ---; grep -n "size\|hasClear\|startContent\|placeholder" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "export interface SwitchProps\|export interface CheckboxProps" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; grep -n "content\|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -8; echo ---; grep -n "variant\|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|TEXT_COLORS" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/constants.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "ArrowToggleProps" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ArrowToggle/ArrowToggle.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -i -E "^(CircleXmark|ArrowRightFromSquare|PersonGear|ChevronDown|ChevronUp|TrashBin|FileArrowDown|ArrowsRotateLeft|Boxes3|Box|CreditCard|Envelope|Layers|Funnel|ChartColumn|SquareDashed|ListUl|CirclePlay|CircleDashed|Circle)\.js$" | tr '\n' ' '

sed -i "s|import type { ActionsPanelItem } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';|import type { ActionsPanelProps } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n\ntype ActionsPanelItem = ActionsPanelProps['actions'][number];|" src/components/OrdersPage.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo TSC_OK && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -15 && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -12

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer") ; echo "---browser check done"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
